nodes.label: Setting — Varenhold Districts
nodes.rationale: Six districts with sensory detail, d6 encounter tables, district hooks, grey sickness 3-stage, skill check system

nodes.label: Grey Sickness
nodes.rationale: 3-stage disease in Varenhold. Creates campaign urgency. Petra Vane has Stage 1. Care houses manage it at Low Tragedy tone

nodes.label: Ashring Quarter
nodes.rationale: District with scorched stones and 50-year ozone smell. Location of Ashring Plaza (ritual focal point). Secondary Archive with junior archivist Meva

nodes.label: Lowmark District
nodes.rationale: District with grey sickness concentration and Dawnhalls. Site of most NPC encounters with vulnerable population

nodes.label: Spire Quarter
nodes.rationale: Scholar district. Ashring Plaza is here. Civic Repository (Archive) is northeast of Chancellor's Hall. Problem-solver player domain

nodes.label: Varenhold Civic Repository (Archive)
nodes.rationale: Three-floor archive. Ground: public. Second: Theron's desk, magic theory, celestial events. Third: restricted, Corven's correspondence, sealed drawer

nodes.label: Dawnhalls
nodes.rationale: Lowmark facility housing Dawnborn. Has vault beneath it (session 0.5). Kitchen with Mira cook. Site of Reckoning infiltration and Petra's captivity

nodes.label: Skill Check Display System
nodes.rationale: Two CSS classes: skill-passive (auto-known by qualified characters) and skill-reveal (requires roll). TODO: JS prototype planned
